name: ANTI-TG
description: Anti-Tg measures thyroglobulin antibodies and evaluates autoimmune thyroid disease. This test complements anti-TPO for comprehensive autoimmune thyroid assessment and monitoring thyroid cancer recurrence.

testdeatils.instrumentation: Abbott Architect, Roche Elecsys, Beckman Coulter

literatureReview: Anti-Tg (Thyroglobulin Antibodies) are markers of autoimmune thyroid disease. Normal <115 IU/mL. Positive in Hashimoto's thyroiditis and Graves' disease, though less sensitive than anti-TPO. High titers can interfere with thyroglobulin measurement in thyroid cancer monitoring. Chemiluminescent immunoassay provides reliable detection. Used in evaluation of autoimmune thyroid disease and as adjunct to thyroglobulin testing in differentiated thyroid cancer follow-up. Positive antibodies indicate autoimmune etiology. May be negative in some autoimmune cases where anti-TPO is positive. Results guide diagnosis and monitoring of thyroid autoimmune disorders.
